findings.finding: All 1,099 ledger reservations reconcile with native attempt IDs; no assigned per-task budget exceeded; no seed mismatch.

At audit time, all 288 evaluated policy manifests and 188 evaluation freeze manifests matched their files. No inspected development API completion occurred after the corresponding first held-out test.

Main-case saved API request schemas contain no provider-side browsing, server-side MCP/container or remote-media capability. Recorded command access candidates and reviewed public adapter boundaries showed no prohibited task-source read.

One ASPIRE demo-only tool call lacks a transcript response. Its call is retained in development_api/0969_2657a508/events.jsonl and all five redirected offline sweep outputs survive; no simulator was used. The missing transcript response is not fabricated.

ASPIRE optional interaction-only R5 and demo&interaction R3 each lack one transcript response. RAX interaction-only R5 has two unfinalized PickXtimes reservations, both retained in its five-attempt budget; their final step totals are incomplete.
RAX demo&interaction R10 PickHighlight has one truncated api-request metadata line. Complete saved API request files parse, and all native tool IDs reconcile.
Ten RAX demo-only policies have disclosed operator corrections for camera_poses.position_m. Optional configurations also contain declared corrections. These are not unmodified native submissions.

The frozen training snapshot differs from current v2 in ten recordings and nine oracle-derived execution limits across ButtonUnmaskSwap, MoveCube, PickHighlight, RouteStick and VideoRepick. Seed identities, difficulty, variants and variation profiles match; current test metadata identity/variation/budget checks match. Do not relabel the historical development as a v2 rerun.
